name: shixue-workbench
description: 面向历史研究的本地工作台
author: 史学工作台

scripts.build:backend: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --onedir --distpath build/backend --hidden-import sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql.psycopg --collect-all psycopg_binary --collect-all fastembed --collect-all rapidocr_onnxruntime --collect-all onnxruntime --collect-all jieba --collect-all opencc --add-data "backend/migrations;backend/migrations" --add-data "backend/data;backend/data" --hidden-import backend.knowledge.product_runtime --hidden-import backend.knowledge.activation --hidden-import backend.knowledge.compat --hidden-import backend.knowledge.catalog --hidden-import backend.knowledge.project_sources --hidden-import backend.knowledge.execution --hidden-import backend.knowledge.unified_api --name ShixueWorkbenchService backend/app.py
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:ui && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build:ui && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.dist:candidate: npm run build:ui && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win nsis portable --config.directories.output=release/v0.5.0-rc.12 --config.appId=cn.shixue.workbench.candidate --config.productName=史学工作台候选版 --config.nsis.shortcutName=史学工作台候选版
